title: ALMA Lensing Cluster Survey: a strongly lensed multiply imaged dusty system at z ≥ 6
question: Characterise the physical properties and dust production rate of an intrinsically faint, strongly lensed, quintuply-imaged dusty galaxy MACS0600-z6 at z = 6.07 near the end of cosmic reionisation.

evidence.quote: The foreground source was identified in the public RELICS catalogue (cite: Salmon2020) and assigned a photometric redshift of $\rm{z_{phot}}$=0.82$^{+0.28}_{-0.40}$.

what.value: Stacked spectrum of 81 Lyman Break Galaxies used for spectroscopic redshift fitting

evidence.quote: We determined the spectroscopic redshift by fitting our observed spectra with a stacked spectra coming from 81 LBGs (cite: Jones2012).

what.value: [C II] 158 um emission line detections, redshift z = 6.07, and line flux ratios

evidence.quote: \[CII\]158$\mu$m emission lines at $z=6.07$ are detected in all images of this system that are covered by ALMA’s FOV: the arc, z6.3b and z6.4, strengthening further the adopted lensing configuration
More extensive details on these detections are given in a companion paper (Fujimoto et al., submitted).

recipe.goal: Extract ALMA 1.2 mm continuum fluxes and identify sources
recipe.method: Identify sources with SNR >= 4 on the 2'' uv-tapered mosaic and extract peak and integrated fluxes on a line-free / emission-line subtracted 1.2 mm image using CASA imfit.

recipe.goal: Extract multi-wavelength optical/NIR/IRAC photometry and deblend overlapping sources
recipe.method: Search within 2'' radius on HST RELICS images, build catalogues with SExtractor in dual-image mode on PSF-matched images, and deblend overlapping sources (foreground, arc, z6.3a, z6.3b) using Sersic profile modelling with GALFIT on WFC3-NIR, ACS, and IRAC images.
key_parameters: DETECT_THRESH = 2 sigma; ANALYSIS_THRESH = 2 sigma; DETECT_MINAREA = 5 px
Error bars measured in 0.4'' radius circle on residual image; upper limits in 0.4'' (HST), 0.8'' (HAWK-I), 1.2'' (IRAC) radius apertures

recipe.method: Template-based SED fitting using HYPERZ for the foreground source and multiple images.
key_parameters: 0 < z < 8 (or z in [0.0:3.0] for foreground); 0.0 < A_v < 3.0 mag
assumptions: Chabrier IMF, solar metallicity templates from Bruzual & Charlot (2003), empirical SEDs from Coleman et al. (1980), starburst templates from Kinney et al. (1996), and Calzetti (2000) reddening law

recipe.goal: Construct cluster lens models, identify multiple images, and compute magnifications and UV-FIR offset
recipe.method: Build three independent cluster mass models using GLAFIC, LENSTOOL, and Light-Traces-Mass (LTM) constrained by 9 other secure multiply-imaged systems (5 with MUSE redshifts) to predict multiple image positions and magnification factors, and measure UV-to-FIR spatial offset.
key_parameters: Three to four dark matter halos for parametric models
assumptions: Pseudo isothermal elliptical mass distributions and empirical scaling relations for parametric models; dark matter follows smoothed luminosity-weighted galaxy distribution for LTM

recipe.goal: Confirm spectroscopic redshift and measure Ly-alpha upper limit with Gemini/GMOS
recipe.method: Reduce Gemini-North/GMOS spectra using Gemini IRAF package, extract spectrum in 1.5 x seeing diameter aperture, bin by factor of 30 in spectral direction, fit with stacked spectrum of 81 LBGs via chi^2 minimization, and inspect 2D spectra for Ly-alpha emission.
key_parameters: 1.5 x seeing diameter extraction aperture; spectral binning factor of 30; redshift search range z = 0 to z = 8
assumptions: Magnification factor mu = 31 for intrinsic EW upper limit

recipe.goal: Derive intrinsic physical properties, galaxy size, stellar age, and SN dust production rate
recipe.method: Fit SEDs with MAGPHYS for dust-detected images (arc and z6.3b) and BAGPIPES for remaining images, measure UV slope beta, compute intrinsic size on z6.4 following Oesch et al. (2010), estimate stellar age from Balmer Break amplitude (F160W vs 4.5 um), and compute dust mass produced per core-collapse supernova.
key_parameters: BAGPIPES: constant SFH, stellar mass 10^6 to 10^12 M_sun, age 0.0 Gyr to age of Universe at z=6.07
assumptions: H_0 = 70 km s^-1 Mpc^-1, Omega_m = 0.3, Omega_Lambda = 0.7
LTM model magnifications; dust temperature T_dust = 30 K (also tested 35 K for IRX and 85 K upper limit) and dust emissivity beta = 2.0; Chabrier IMF
